shallow depth of field, close-up editorial composition highlighting the dual-texture waffle-exterior and terry-interior construction, rule of thirds framing, heavy negative space in upper portion, vertical 4:5 portrait format for Instagram feed,

ultra-high resolution 8K commercial product photography no watermark no text overlay
